subject: general
question: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 5 hours, 8 hours and 12 hours, respectively. If all the pipes are opened at the same time, then the time taken to fill the tank is:
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can fill the tank in 5 hours.

Pipe B can fill the tank in 8 hours.

Pipe C can fill the tank in 12 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Time taken to fill the tank when all pipes are opened = 1 / (1/A + 1/B + 1/C)

**Calculation:**

Rate at which pipe A fills the tank = 1/5

Rate at which pipe B fills the tank = 1/8

Rate at which pipe C fills the tank = 1/12

Combined rate = 1/5 + 1/8 + 1/12

To find a common denominator:

⇒ 1/5 = 24/120

⇒ 1/8 
= 15/120

⇒ 1/12 = 10/120

Combined rate = 24/120 + 15/120 + 10/120

⇒ Combined rate = 49/120

Time taken to fill the tank = 1 / (49/120)

⇒ Time taken = 120 / 49

⇒ Time taken = 2(22)/(49) hours

**The time taken to fill the tank when all pipes are opened is 2(22)/(49) hours.**
